surface.name: Tándem driver and trusted-contact app
surface.subject: Freight trip and trusted-contact coordination
surface.audience: LATAM freight owner-operators with one or two trucks and accepted contacts; es and pt-BR
surface.job: Prepare/confirm a trip, share scoped source-aged facts, report intent and contact action, and distinguish unresolved delivery/help

direction.rationale: The user confirmed the supplied identity, semantic tokens, Manrope font and six reference states. Implement that system without inventing another visual direction.
direction.signature: Two paths together in the supplied outlined Tándem identity, stable labelled OK/pause/SOS actions and separate attributed trip facts.
typography: Bundled Manrope, SIL OFL; body18/28, support16/24, heading22/30, title28/36, labels18/24
Exact roles and weights from docs/design/tokens.json; no rasterized interface text
direction.layout: Use the supplied prepare/review/active/offline/deferred/contact-incident references as responsive component guidance. Keep critical actions stable and visible independently of optional illustrations or the tour.
direction.motion: Feedback120ms; reduced motion0; no driving decoration or automatic tour.
direction.density: Low density for driver actions, compact labelled event rows for facts, generous separation between tasks; high-priority state stays in first390x844viewport
direction.copyVoice: Plain Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese, sentence case, named action verbs, source-attributed reports, explicit unknown and recovery. Camiones/Caminhões, no jargon or implied emergency guarantee.
accessibility: Text contrast>=4.5:1 and boundaries/focus>=3:1 measured in the actual app
Targets minimum48px, primary64px, in-route80px, gap16px; text may enlarge
Preserve keyboard focus and scroll during locale changes; semantic labels and readable errors
ES/pt-BR, text enlargement and reduced motion without horizontal overflow
No personal trip or participant details in generic noindex metadata
antiDefaults: No fake live map/green safety status
No generated testimonials, credibility badges or invented delivery
No decorative stripes, gradients, identical icon tiles or nested cards
No bot/composer/typing affordances without backend capability
No countdown owned solely by browser; unknown source age remains explicit

sources.reason: Apply product craft while the confirmed Tándem source overrides generic color and visual preferences; personal installation paths remain outside source

implementation.componentSystem: One existing React/TypeScript/Vite web foundation with shared Tándem tokens, controls, router and ES/pt-BR provider
constraints: web/package and shared UI belong49; root backend/CI belongs44; no duplicate dependency files
41 additive read routes,45 transport,42 observation queue,50 driver,51 contact/privacy; typed interfaces reconcile through actual contracts
No pretend login: real externally issuedOIDC or explicitly synthetic local test session only
Required utility metadata/noindex, generic share assets, graceful404; no external analytics
Every module needs rendered state/control/viewport evidence and independent acceptance before software completion
Use only published authenticated backend contracts, and independent route/gateway recovery; no second application or rasterized screens.

acceptance.statement: Driver can persist an owned truck, accepted contacts and explicitly confirmed trip against the actual backend; reload preserves facts
acceptance.source: User complete-app instruction; issues13–19; Robert runtime

acceptance.statement: Response/location/server-check/channel facts remain separate; stale/offline/revoked/error transitions cannot imply safety or delivery
SOS is visibly pending until accepted; contact acknowledgement/action and owner resolution remain distinct and access scoped
Every meaningful control works with error/loading/permission and duplicate-input states in es/pt-BR at mobile+desktop targets
Visual/manual check-in never becomes mandatory while moving to prevent an alarm; unqualified sensor modes and wake lock limits stay explicit
Every actionable review finding is resolved/responded with evidence before integration; no author self-signoff
acceptance.source: User mutual review correction and continuous-build instruction
